entry.title: Shehbaz Sharif directs authorities to expedite Sindh flood relief
entry.summary: The prime minister ordered relevant departments to speed up relief efforts in flood-hit districts of Sindh during a review meeting.

entry.title: Karachi records heavy traffic disruption after overnight rain
entry.summary: Several Karachi roads remained waterlogged on Friday morning after heavy overnight rainfall disrupted traffic across the city.

entry.title: Pakistan cricket board announces squad for upcoming Asia Cup
entry.summary: The PCB named a 16-member squad for the Asia Cup, with a young pace bowler included for the first time.

entry.title: Petrol prices likely to rise in next fortnightly review
entry.summary: Sources in the finance ministry said petrol prices may increase by up to five rupees per litre in the next review.

entry.title: Balochistan government announces compensation for attack victims
entry.summary: The provincial government announced financial compensation for families of those killed in recent militant attacks in Balochistan.
